messages.content: Predict this participant’s next decision in a public goods experiment. There are 20 separate one-shot rounds. Each round involves four people: this participant and three new anonymous other players. Everyone starts that round with USD 8. Each person either keeps ALL USD 8 or gives ALL USD 8 to the group; partial contributions are unavailable. Add the contributions of all four people, double that total, then divide it equally among all four, including anyone who kept their money. Each person’s round earnings are their retained money plus that equal share. If your contribution is c and the other three contribute a total O, your earnings are 8-c+2*(c+O)/4 dollars. Their current decisions are unknown before your choice. There is no decision time limit. After each choice, feedback shows each player’s contribution, the doubled group total, and each player’s resulting earnings, in three stages of 5 seconds each. The next round then starts with three new players. Other players’ choices come from actual recorded human decisions; you were informed that your anonymous choices could also influence future participants’ payments. A USD 10 participation fee is paid, plus earnings from one randomly selected round, up to USD 20 extra. Instructions and a comprehension check precede the task, followed by an experimenter walkthrough of two example rounds illustrating individual and collective incentives. The clinical descriptors below are preexisting background supplied for prediction; they do not imply that the participant was shown numeric brain measurements. Predict the amount this person contributes in the current round. Output only 0 (keep all USD 8) or 8 (give all USD 8), with no explanation.

Participant background: healthy comparison participant without brain damage. Measured damage as a percentage of each region of interest: vmPFC 0%; dlPFC 0%; amygdala 0%. Individual age and gender are not available.
Current round: 1 of 20. You have a fresh USD 8 and face three new anonymous players.
No preceding experimental round has occurred.
